children: Light announced DOE Launch Pad INL selection that creates an accelerated pathway to produce Lead Test Assemblies via the SHED program.
DOE selected Light to participate in Launch Pad INL, enabling a DOE-authorized SHED facility to produce Lead Test Assemblies.
SHED (Special HALEU Extrusion Demonstration) bypasses NRC licensing for pilot LTAs, potentially speeding time-to-market by several years.
Light expects current cash/resources to fund SHED construction, operation, and decommissioning based on preliminary estimates.
SHED will inform design and accelerate NRC licensing for the Lightbridge Expandable Fuel Facility (LEFF), reducing cost and schedule risk.
Company plans to provide further updates on post-irradiation exam results, SHED design/site work, LEFF site selection, and cost/timeline assumptions.
